genes.name: tiebreak_critical
genes.hypothesis: The score is a minimum over 2^m sign choices, so most single moves leave it unchanged and the walk is blind on plateaus; preferring states with fewer sign choices attaining the minimum gives the plateau a slope towards the next improvement.
genes.predicted: +0.005 to +0.02 at m = 15 at equal CPU time, despite the slower counting evaluation
genes.author: seed

genes.name: ascent_moves
genes.hypothesis: At a plateau the score is the minimum of many tight sign choices, each the maximum of linear terms; a single coordinate move cannot raise them all, but a move of all coordinates along a direction that raises every tight choice's active term (found by a perceptron on their gradients) can.
genes.predicted: +0.01 to +0.04 at m = 15, mostly by leaving the A = 1 plateau
genes.author: seed

genes.name: refine_grid
genes.hypothesis: A coarse grid makes the search combinatorial and fast to explore; doubling the denominator after a cycle without a new best then lets the balanced min-max settle between grid points.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: grid_den
genes.hypothesis: Every u_i and v_i is a multiple of 1/grid_den; 24 holds halves, thirds, quarters, sixths and eighths while keeping the space small.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: step_max
genes.hypothesis: A move changes one coordinate by 1 to step_max grid units; small steps for refinement, larger to cross between basins.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: t0
genes.hypothesis: Starting annealing temperature in score units; about one grid step of score loss should be accepted often early in a cycle.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: cycle
genes.hypothesis: Iterations per annealing cycle before restarting from the best state; short cycles exploit, long ones explore.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: kick
genes.hypothesis: Random coordinate moves applied to the best state at each restart so that cycles do not repeat the same walk.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: tie_accept
genes.hypothesis: Probability of still accepting an equal-score move that increases the number of tight sign choices; zero risks getting stuck, one disables the tiebreak.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: ascent_prob
genes.hypothesis: Share of proposals that are ascent moves; each costs a full counting evaluation, so a small share keeps throughput.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: refine_max
genes.hypothesis: How many times the grid may be doubled; three doublings of 1/24 reach 1/192.
